# Licking County Deck Builders
## https://lickingcountydeckbuilders.com

Licking County Deck Builders provides residential deck design, construction, repair, and replacement across Licking County, Ohio, including Newark, Granville, Heath, Pataskala, and Johnstown.

## Services

- Composite Decks — low-maintenance composite decking installation
- Wood Decks — traditional pressure-treated and cedar deck construction
- Deck Repair — board replacement, structural repair, railing repair
- Deck Replacement — full tear-out and rebuild
- Pergolas — custom pergola design and construction
- Custom Decks — multi-level decks, built-in seating, custom features

## Service Area

Licking County, Ohio, including:
- Newark, OH
- Pataskala, OH
- New Albany, OH
- Granville, OH
- Heath, OH
- Hebron, OH
- Johnstown, OH
